kicker: Aerospace & defence · 26 companies reported Q2 FY27
title: Defence revenue grew 42%. Private suppliers led.
dek: Order books are turning into revenue: the median defence company grew sales 42% year on year, and defence indigenisation came up on 93 Q2 calls, up from 80 two quarters ago.

read: The defence order cycle is now visible in revenue, and the smaller private suppliers of electronics, drones and components are converting it fastest.
sources: Vantage analysis of Q2 FY27 results filed on BSE (consolidated where available), as of 18 Nov 2026; theme counts from Vantage call tracker
